planned_leftist_client.next_new_mathematics: Actual leftist-merge comparison recurrence and rank bound
specification: A measured recursion follows Search.LeftistQueue.combineQ exactly, charging zero priority comparisons at an empty operand and one at each nonempty comparison before the same right-child recursive call.
Prove its returned value equals combineQ for all inputs.
If Ranked a and Ranked b, prove comparisons(a,b) <= rank a + rank b; only rank validity is needed for this bound, not heap order.
Derive comparisons <= log2(size a+1)+log2(size b+1) via existing rank_log, then explicit total-size bounds.
Separately derive merge-call count C+1, rank-test/constructor counts when modeled, and explicit source-cost weighted bounds; preserve unit-cost premises.
reuse: Applications/Search/LeftistQueue.lean: combineQ, combineQ_entries, combineQ_valid, rank_paths, rank_size, rank_log
examples: Both empty cases, singleton merge, nonempty priority tie with different payloads, non-antisymmetric priority preorder.
Equal child ranks preserve their order; right-heavy child pair swaps; a Heap-only forged rank does not satisfy Ranked.
Self-meld doubles occurrences; repeated entry insertion preserves multiplicity.
A valid rank-2 root demonstrates direct peek has zero priority comparisons while delete merges children and has one.
excluded_from_slice: Claim that root rank alone bounds deletion
Pair-round linear build or any weight-biased/binomial/red-black exercise
